stories.title: The 14 college football teams poised to break through and bounce back in 2026
stories.summary: Which teams and players are poised for the next step? Which are ready to put a down 2025 behind them?

stories.title: Mayfield felt 'disrespected' by Bucs' deal offers
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield said Thursday that he felt "disrespected a little bit" that he and the team could not reach an agreement on a new contract before his imposed deadline of the start of training camp.

stories.title: Pack legend Green reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
stories.summary: Ahman Green, 49, the Green Bay Packers' career rushing leader, revealed that he has Parkinson's disease.

stories.title: Police: Romo had open bottle of alcohol in car
stories.summary: CBS NFL analyst and former Cowboys quarterback Tony Romo had an open container of alcohol in his vehicle when he was arrested last week on suspicion of driving under the influence, police say.

stories.title: Bieniemy's son to undergo mental health check
stories.summary: Two court appearances scheduled for the 27-year-old son of Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy in connection with the shooting of his mother at their Virginia home have been delayed pending a mental health evaluation.
